    ConceptMapWriter
    Writes Mappings as a FHIR R4 ConceptMap, so that a mapping maintained in any of IPF's formats can be published as the standard resource for the job - authored on from there in Simplifier or Forge, shipped in an Implementation Guide, or served by a terminology server.
